name: @malinamnam/pi-phone
description: A phone-first remote UI for Pi that lets you drive a real Pi session from your phone. pi-phone starts a small local web server, launches a dedicated pi --mode rpc subprocess in your current project, and mirrors Pi's session state over WebSocket to a mobile web app.
